C22 and C09 share the congratulation-on-becoming-prime-minister function, but their language and structure are less closely aligned.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I wish to convey my sincere greetings and best wishes ... and to congratulate you on the occasion of your reappointment and investiture as Prime Minister of Greece.","parent_excerpt":"On the occasion of your investiture as Governor General of the Federation of Nigeria, it gives me great pleasure to extend to you ... cordial greetings and heartiest congratulations.","explanation":"Distinctive parallel opening machinery combines the occasion of investiture with greetings and congratulations."},{"child_excerpt":"I am confident that ... our two nations will continue to work together in the spirit of firm friendship which has traditionally characterized Greek and American relations.","parent_excerpt":"I know that ... your years in this high office will be marked by peace and prosperity for your people and by ever-closer relations between Nigeria and the United States.","explanation":"Both follow the congratulations with confidence or hope for the leader's tenure and strengthened bilateral relations."}]}
